title: Ride the north coast on horseback
description: The Menorcan horse — black, tall and unhurried — isn't only for fiesta days: it is also the oldest way to travel this coast. Rides leave Son Àngel through the north of Ciutadella, between dry-stone walls and pine wood, out to the sea at Algaiarens. It goes at a walking pace, in small groups; book ahead.
